title: Respectful Relationships (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to build respectful, safe, and stable relationships with partners and children, reducing fear and increasing emotional security.
learningOutcomes: Understand respectful behaviour in the context of fatherhood.
Recognise how disrespect affects children’s emotional wellbeing.
Learn how to build trust and safety in the family.

modules.title: Respect in Fathering
modules.content: Explores how respect shapes children’s emotional development.

modules.title: Behaviours That Harm or Support Respect
modules.content: Identifies patterns that create fear or stability.

modules.title: Building Safe Family Relationships
modules.content: Provides tools for consistent, respectful behaviour.
